---
title: Test
output: pdf_document
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---
```{r}
library(knitr)
df <- data.frame(Subteste = c("DC", "DC", "DC", "IMe", "IMe", "IMe"), Val = 1:6)
ls <- ifelse(df$Subteste[-1] == df$Subteste[-nrow(df)], "", "\\hline")
ls <- c(ls, "")
kable(df, format="latex", booktabs=TRUE, linesep=ls)
```
